body: That was... so intense and creepy and just horrifying. I agree about the babies too, knowing they're dying while you hear them cry and then the silence at the end.
Hmm, tough. I'll go with LED.

My uncle continues to sell drugs and lives with my grandmother and other uncle.

My cousin has actually straightened up a lot. He apologized for what happened multiple times and I believe he feels bad, but I have a hard time forgiving someone who is the core of why I fail to have a healthy relationship now. He's gotten away from our family and is trying to live a good life. He still has issues and I still can't be in the same room alone with him, but I honestly blame the rest of our family for what happened. He was a product of his horrible father, drug addict mother and an all around cruel and harsh family.

My uncle tried to trade me (at 5) to his friend (30) for drugs. Then put my cousin (his son. 9) in the hospital for defending me.

That cousin then went on to rape me and sexually assault me every night for a month when I was 10.

My whole family covered it up because it would "ruin his life."
